One thing I worry about with the [positions table](https://mozilla.github.io/standards-positions/) is that it's not obvious to readers that the entries expand.  Yet the parts that are visible when you expand them are an important part of the message we're trying to convey.

To remedy this, I'd like to make roughly the following changes:
* add expand/collapse triangles at the left edge, replacing (I think) the "Details" column and icon
  * probably this requires moving the link icon to the right edge, but not entirely sure
* add [Expand All] and [Collapse All] buttons at the top

Thoughts?
